headline: New enclosure for cemetery entrances, new double death vault, Hearst-Receiving Tomb cemetery fencing and barn siding, and reimbursement of Cemetery Trust fund.
summary: The meeting covers a new enclosure for cemetery entrances and a new double death vault. It also covers old business on Hearst-Receiving Tomb, cemetery fencing, and barn siding, plus reimbursement of the Cemetery Trust fund.
